title: Cosmic Butterfly Eye
description: A surreal creature with a large central green eye containing a crescent moon, topped by a purple smiling orb with orange spots. It has wide orange butterfly wings decorated with multiple small green figures wearing yellow headwraps. The being has two long green trailing legs and floats against a swirling cosmic nebula background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy creature featuring a large detailed green eye with a crescent moon pupil, topped by a round purple smiling face with orange dots. It possesses wide orange butterfly wings covered in small green figures with yellow headwraps. The being has two long flowing green legs trailing below. Set against a vibrant swirling cosmic nebula background with purple and green clouds and stars, whimsical and colorful style.
